title: Content-Type check case-sensitive; RFC 7231 says media types are case-insensitive
description: subscribe_events checks ct.starts_with('text/event-stream') where ct is the raw header value. RFC 7231 §3.1.1.1 says media types are case-insensitive, so TEXT/EVENT-STREAM is valid. Fixed by adding .to_ascii_lowercase() before the starts_with check.
